name: Onna Kyoushi wa Mou Gaman Dekinai
original_name: 女教師はもう我慢できない
source:
The protagonist was stalking a female student that caught his interest. That was when Shijou Megumi, a teacher, intervened. Hoping to put the stalking to a stop, she suggested take her place, under the condition that the stalking stopped.

If it were for the sake of her dear student, she'd put up with any embarassment, but their acts gradually escalated... Eventually, Megumi found herself unable to hold back any longer!
translation:
主人公一直跟踪一名令他感兴趣的女学生。就在这时，教师四条惠介入了。为了制止跟踪行为，她提出由自己代替那名学生，条件是主人公必须停止跟踪。

只要是为了心爱的学生，她愿意忍受任何羞耻，可两人的行为逐渐升级……最终，惠发现自己再也无法克制！
